name: Scotiabank Arena
notes: NHL Maple Leafs and NBA Raptors home arena. Major concert venue.

name: Rogers Centre
notes: MLB Blue Jays home stadium; ~53,000 for concerts. Retractable roof, baseball ~39,150; concert mode up to ~54,000.

name: Rogers Stadium
notes: Outdoor concert venue at Downsview Park, opened 2025. Major touring acts., transit: bus routes only within 600m; nearest subway Sheppard West ~1700m — accepted; reconsider with per-venue radius override in future calibration

name: BMO Field
notes: Toronto FC (MLS) and Toronto Argonauts (CFL) home. Open air. temporarily expanded to ~45,736 for FIFA World Cup matches, June–July 2026.

name: RBC Amphitheatre
notes: Major outdoor amphitheatre at Ontario Place. Seasonal (open air, May-Oct)., transit: zero TTC stops within 600m (Ontario Place across the Lake Shore divide) — accepted; reconsider with per-venue radius override in future calibration

name: Coca-Cola Coliseum
notes: AHL Toronto Marlies home. Mid-size concerts and family shows.

name: Meridian Hall
notes: Major performing arts (formerly Sony Centre / O'Keefe Centre). Below 5k threshold but regularly hosts touring headliners that materially affect downtown crowds.
aliases: Sony Centre for the Performing Arts

name: Massey Hall
notes: Iconic concert hall. Below 5k threshold but a major touring booker; excluding it would drop the entire mid-size concert tier downtown.

name: Roy Thomson Hall
notes: Toronto Symphony Orchestra home. Below 5k threshold; included for the same reason as Massey — major downtown crowd driver.

name: Ed Mirvish Theatre
notes: Major touring Broadway venue (Mirvish). Below 5k threshold; long-running tours materially affect Yonge-Dundas crowds.

name: Princess of Wales Theatre
notes: Major touring Broadway venue (Mirvish). Below 5k threshold; included alongside Ed Mirvish for the King St West theatre district crowd.

name: History
notes: Live Nation venue in the Beach; major touring acts. Below 5k threshold but a regular headline booker.
